newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT Exploration reports Thai oil find.
newsitem.headline: PTT Exploration reports Thai oil find.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration and Production Plc said on Friday that it had found crude oil apart from natural gas and condensate from offshore Bongkot field that it is selling to state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand.

PTT Exploration and Production said in a filing to the Thai stock exchange that the find in the field in the Gulf of Thailand was made during a project development in which the drilling base found two levels of rock layer which yielded oil or condensate.
The Bongkot gas field is operated by Total Exploration and Production Co Ltd, a unit of Total SA. PTTEP has a 40 percent stake in the project.
The company said the oil find would require drilling more holes in 1997 and 1998 as well as a study on increasing condensate production capacity.
Currently, the Petroleum Authority of Thailand buys 350 million cubic feet per day (MMCFD) of natural gas and 11,000 barrels of condensate per day.
Production of natural gas at the Bongkot field now stands at 410 MMCFD and 11,000 barrels per day of condensate.
It said an ongoing development project would boost production of natural gas to 630 MMCFD and condensate to 13,000 barrels per day at the maximum.
